newsitem.title: DUBAI: PRESS DIGEST - United Arab Emirates - April 29.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - United Arab Emirates - April 29.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the United Arab Emirates press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Deputy Prime Minister Sultan bin Zayed hails UAE-Egypt ties.
- Dubai's economy set to grow by more than nine percent annually for "forseeable future" - official.
- Life insurance in Arab world set to grow substantially in the next 10 years.
- Dubai's foreign trade to reach $100 billion by the year 2010.

- The third Middle East Communications Expo (Midcom 97) will open in Abu Dhabi on Tuesday. Major global telecommunications companies and decision makers will attend and contracts worth millions of dollars to supply equipment are expected to be signed.
- Emaar Properties becomes talk of the towm after officials raised the share quota for nationals.
- UAE banks performing well so far this year, officials of the banking association said.
